reason: 5.20.0 lands the 2026-08-11 whole-codebase adversarial review: eight parallel finders, an independent default-refuted skeptic per finding, 24 confirmed defects fixed. Headline is the evidence classifier - a newline instead of && , or quotes around the binary name, dropped a catastrophic command's grade from 100 to 35/30 and erased every flag - plus idempotent replay that served a prior allow to a different act. Adds the third enforcement-visibility guarantee (ungoverned_scope: a client narrowing DASHCLAW_GOVERNED_CATEGORIES is no longer invisible to the server) and `dashclaw backfill`, the reader for the orphan-actions file the hook has always promised would be reconciled. Platform, hooks and CLI only - neither SDK's source changed, so neither is republished.
